obligations.text: Explicit reference-system/axis/unit/altitude/time and stored/display/export coordinate contract with bounded geometry/support and ambiguity handling
Record/project/media identity, revisions, edit/delete/reimport/duplicate semantics and conflicts between diverged copies
Interrupted import/save/merge recovery and honest incomplete/committed distinction without silent record loss
Bounded large observation access/index/cache/viewport/export/cancel and offline map/media/license support investigated honestly
Accessible record/conflict/status editing, keyboard operation, reversible edits and visible offline/provenance state
>=2 independently useful candidate-discovered implementation precedents, exact sources/pins and plan consequences
Real candidate-discovered issue/failure -> associated fix -> regression-test chain with applicability/evidence limits
Coherent architecture/support/merge boundary, critical dependencies, >=1 opportunity and >=1 alternative; optional adoption distinguished
Standalone source-correct complete final with preserved meaning and honest executed versus proposed transform/index/merge validation

dimension_note: Common eight dimensions apply as relevant to actual obligation, no facet count or aggregate score. Full PASS additionally assesses all consequential current final claims.
release_rule: Only after both recipes/selection rationale are locked; no intra-block feedback.
